role.title: Vacation Program Student — Mechanical & Automation Engineering
role.overview: Join MinRes's engineering innovation teams working on active capital projects, autonomous road trains, and high-tech processing plants to solve complex reliability and automation bottlenecks.

advertisedRequirements: Penultimate or final year student in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Systems, or Electrical Engineering
High academic achievement with strong analytical and mathematical problem-solving skills
Exposure to CAD, sensor telemetry, and mechanical reliability evaluation
Demonstrated drive, curiosity, and adaptability to work on mega-scale Australian industrial projects
Australian working rights and readiness to undertake WA site rotations

identifiedOperationalBottlenecks.teamStrain: Senior innovation engineers spend hours manually wrangling dirty vehicle CAN bus and sensor telemetry logs to troubleshoot autonomous vehicle faults.
Updating FMEA matrices, asset reliability logs, and mechanical failure reports manually drains lead engineering capacity.

identifiedOperationalBottlenecks.requirement: Australian Mining & Heavy Vehicle Standards Compliance
identifiedOperationalBottlenecks.teamStrain: Auditing autonomous haulage equipment against AS/NZS heavy vehicle and mining safety standards causes compliance review backlogs.
Writing repetitive parameter sweeps and kinematic simulation scripts for haul road dynamics slows down sprint releases.
